messages.subject: HMC Refactor V1
parts:
I pushed a supposedly working refactoring of mcmc to the hmc_refactor branch. Right now there's only one sampler, a unit metric Hamiltonian with constant integration time (set equal to 100 because I didn't want to deal with the command line option refactoring quite yet), but it samples and the step-size adaptation appears to be working.

There may be one or two tweaks, but most of the changes from here on in will just be implementing new samplers (diagonal mass, dense mass, nuts, diagonal nuts, dense nuts, and then the infamous Riemannian methods). Hence the refactor should be sufficiently mature for everyone to take a look and tell me how terrible it is. :-) All comments/critiques welcome!

-Mike
